cohort: 258 pregnancies in 151 women with Marfan syndrome delivering between January 1998 and March 2018 in 12 UK centres
finding: In this study of women with Marfan syndrome, there were no maternal deaths, the aortic dissection rate was 1.9% (mainly type B), and there were no identifiable factors associated with aortic dissection.
mod_finding: Caesarean section rates were high (50%), particularly in women with dilated aortic roots.
